thread:
morgan: T-minus 45 to EU change window. Canary rollout starts at 21:00 UTC. Quick state: pin, smoke, rollback thresholds?

alan: Pins applied: frontend@v3.14.2, api@v7.2.0. DB migrations set to no-op. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary start: 21:00 UTC. Command:
```
deploy --env=prod-eu --canary=5% --pins frontend@v3.14.2 api@v7.2.0 --smoke-tests smoke:basic
```

shilpa: Observability ready. Dashboards: /dashboards/canary-eu. Alert threshold copied to ops playbook. I'll watch latency P50/P95 and 5xx.

jo: Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/345 (short list of changes). QA signoff attached.

alan: Smoke checklist: migration=no-op, traffic-switch=gradual, circuit-breaker=enabled. Canary runbook step 3 is manual hold.

sre-oncall: If error rate >1% for >3m or latency P95 increases >200ms -> rollback. Assigning rollback lead: alan.

morgan: Confirm owners: alan (rollback), shilpa (obs), jo (docs/comms), morgan (change-window owner). Anyone else?

shilpa: I’ll step in for rapid rollforward if metric regressions look like noise. :white_check_mark:

alan: Deploy bot started canary @21:00 UTC. Canary traffic 5% -> 10% over 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary update: 5% -> 10% (10m). No errors in smoke tests.

sre-oncall: Noted: minor 502 burst at 21:12 (spike 0.3%). Monitoring.

morgan: Hold at 10% for 20m while we watch latency and error trends. No additional changes unless rollback.

alan: Observed small latency bump P95 +90ms, 5xx at 0.35% over 5m. Within thresholds. Proceed to 25% if stable for next 15m.

morgan: Proceeding to 25% in 5.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 25% canary @21:40 UTC.

jo: Posting short update to #release-notes: "EU change window: canary at 25%, monitoring. Pins in place." link to thread.

sre-oncall: Still under thresholds. Will escalate if breach.

morgan: Good run. If nothing breaches by 22:10 we'll start ramp to 100% and end freeze at 22:30. Keep pins for 30m after ramp.

alan: Acknowledged. Rollback playbook ready: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/api --to-revision=202` pinned version fallback documented.

shilpa: I'll annotate the alert-runbook with observed latency baseline for postmortem comparison.

morgan: Thanks all. Callouts: no code pushes to pinned services until freeze lifts. Keep mobile breaks in separate channel.

deploy-bot: Final: Canary ramp complete expected at 22:25. Any late holds comment now.

alan: none. :rocket:

sre-oncall: I'll stay on until 23:00 to watch for delayed regressions.

morgan: Closing handoff. Great job team. :tada:
